name: MarketNow
description: Trust layer for agent commerce. Discovery is solved (MCP registry, Smithery, Glama); trust is not. MarketNow provides Sentinel security audits, AP2-compatible mandates, all skills free (no payments), and human-in-the-loop-by-default agent spending. 5,023 MCP servers, B2B pricing. AliceLabs LLC proprietary (see SENTINEL-LICENSE), maintained by AliceLabs LLC.

positioning.what_we_are: The trust layer for agent commerce. Not the biggest catalog — the safest place for an agent to spend real money.
positioning.what_we_are_not: A discovery registry. Use registry.modelcontextprotocol.io, Smithery, Glama, or PulseMCP for discovery. Use MarketNow for trust: security audits, payment verification, mandate enforcement, dispute resolution.
positioning.wedge: The official MCP registry solves discovery but has 64.7M entries from 1,691 packages — massive duplication, zero signal, active supply-chain attacks. MarketNow is the trust layer on top of any catalog.

standards.payments: x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required) — implementing, governed by Linux Foundation with Coinbase, Cloudflare, Stripe, Google, Visa
standards.mandates: AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol) — implementing, by Google with Visa/Mastercard/PayPal/Coinbase + 60 partners
standards.discovery: MCP Server Cards — monitoring, will adopt when spec stabilizes
standards.identity: MCP Registry namespace verification — planning, via GitHub OAuth or DNS

trust_model.summary: Three purchase modes designed for both human oversight and agent autonomy. Human-in-the-loop is the default; silent autonomous spending is opt-in only.

notification_modes.notify: DEFAULT — agent buys autonomously, principal gets email/webhook alert on every purchase
notification_modes.notify_and_veto: agent buys, principal gets alert + 5-minute veto window (veto flow on roadmap)
notification_modes.silent: fully autonomous, no alerts. Requires explicit confirmSilentAutonomy=true field — opt-in only

modes.applies_to: Free skills (price = 0) and verified open-source skills
modes.response: license key + system_prompt + install command immediately

modes.applies_to: Paid skills where a valid mandate exists and price <= perPurchaseCapUsd and price <= (spendingLimit - spent). Default notificationMode is 'notify' — the principal is alerted on every purchase.
modes.human_action: None required at purchase time — but receives a notification (email/webhook) immediately after. Can revoke the mandate at any time.
modes.response: license key + system_prompt after on-chain USDC verification; mandate ledger updated; notification sent

modes.applies_to: Paid skills when no mandate is on file, or mandate is exhausted/expired/below cap
modes.agent_action: Receive the response and surface to operator, or wait for mandate creation
modes.human_action: Approve via Stripe Checkout, or create/renew a mandate at /mandates

guarantees: Every paid purchase is verified on-chain via eth_getTransactionReceipt on Base
Every mandate spend is recorded in a public git commit at _data/mandates/ — auditable in the repo history
Mandates default to 'notify' mode — the principal is alerted on every purchase
'silent' mode (no notifications) requires explicit confirmSilentAutonomy=true — opt-in only
Mandates can be revoked instantly by the principal (human wallet owner) from /mandates
Hard caps: max $500 total per mandate, max $50 per single purchase (cannot be raised)
Sentinel v3.0 gVisor sandbox security audit is self-declared — see /trust for the full disclosure and roadmap to third-party audit

pricing.model: MarketNow does NOT sell skills. We administer a free marketplace + sell Sentinel subscriptions to sellers.
pricing.explanation: All 7,063 skills in the catalog are FREE to install and use. MarketNow does not charge per-skill. Our revenue comes from SELLERS who want to list/sell their skills — they subscribe to Sentinel (the security audit pipeline) and we take a commission on each sale.

revenue_streams.1_marketplace_administration: Free — anyone can browse/install the 7,063 skills at no cost
revenue_streams.2_sentinel_subscriptions_for_sellers: Sellers who want to list/sell their skills subscribe to Sentinel
revenue_streams.3_commission_on_sales: When a seller sells a skill, MarketNow takes 20% (15% if affiliate is used)
revenue_streams.4_addons: Featured listings, verified seller badge, priority review
revenue_streams.5_affiliate_program: 5% commission to referrers, paid monthly via Stripe Connect (min $50)

featured_listing.description: Boost your skill to the top of search results

verified_seller_badge.description: Get a ✓ Verified badge on all your skills. Requires KYC verification.

priority_review.description: Skip the queue. Your skill is reviewed within 6 hours instead of 24-48h.

storage_fee.applies_to: FREE tier only (PRO/ENTERPRISE include unlimited storage)
storage_fee.description: FREE tier includes your first 3 skills at no cost. After that, $0.50 per skill per month covers hosting, Sentinel scanning, and continuous monitoring.

commission_on_sales.note: Seller always keeps 80%. The 5% affiliate commission comes out of MarketNow's 20% share.

list_all_skills.returns: Array of all skills with price, category, tags, install command

get_skill.returns: Single skill detail (NOTE: not yet implemented, use list_all_skills and filter client-side)

categories.returns: Array of {name, slug, count} for all categories

search.returns: Array of matching skills with relevance scores

agent_purchase.description: Dual-mode purchase: instant for free / mandated, requires approval otherwise.

body.txHash: string (required for paid — USDC Transfer on Base)
body.mandateId: string (optional — enables autonomous purchase within pre-approved limit)

agent_purchase.verification: USDC Transfer event parsed from eth_getTransactionReceipt on Base (chainId 8453)

actions.create: POST /api/mandates with {owner, agentId, spendingLimitUsd, perPurchaseCapUsd, categories, expiresAt}
actions.spend: POST /api/mandates?action=spend {id, amount, txHash}  (called internally by agent-purchase)

agent_wallet.returns: Payment instructions for agents (USDC contract, Base RPC, code samples in Python/JS)

audit_skill.description: Sentinel L1.5+L1.6+L2 security audit — runs 3 layers: 6 metadata checks + 18 Semgrep rules + 18 secret patterns + OSV API + L2 Docker sandbox results
checks: L1.6 SECRET DETECTION (Stripe, AWS, GitHub, JWT, private keys)
L2 Docker sandbox (if skill has GitHub repo)

certificate_lookup.description: Retrieve the signed Sentinel certificate for a skill. Certificates are regenerated weekly by the batch audit (Sunday 01:00 UTC) and signed with SHA-256.

sentinel_status.description: Aggregate Sentinel status: latest L1.6 batch audit, L2 sandbox coverage, and total certified skills count.

returns.l16_batch: latest weekly batch audit results (Semgrep + Gitleaks + OSV)
returns.l2_sandbox: Docker sandbox coverage with per-skill summaries

actions.issue: POST /api/atc {action:'issue', agent_id, public_key, capabilities?, skill_id?, wallet_address?}
actions.verify: GET /api/atc?action=verify&card_id=ATC-2026-XXXXX — verify an Agent Trust Card (identity, validity, review evidence)
actions.verify_receipt: GET /api/atc?action=verify-receipt&receipt_id=rcpt_xxxxxxxxxxxx — verify a signed delivery proof for a completed purchase
actions.ca_key: GET /api/atc?action=ca-key — Ed25519 CA public key (pin this in your runtime)
actions.translate: POST /api/atc {action:'translate', from, to, message} — translate between LangChain/MCP/AutoGen/CrewAI/OpenAI Functions

what_the_atc_answers: issuer (which CA vouches for the binding)
validity state (valid | revoked, with timestamp + reason)
review evidence (Sentinel score, layers passed, audit timestamp, artifact hash)
what_the_atc_does_NOT_answer: should this agent be trusted? (runtime policy decision)
is this agent safe for MY context? (consumer decides)
will this agent behave at runtime? (covered by L3, separate layer)

action_receipts.description: Signed delivery proof for completed purchases. Emitted automatically by POST /api/agent-purchase on instant_purchase and direct_purchase modes.
action_receipts.storage: _data/receipts/{receipt_id}.json in the public GitHub repo (audit ledger)
action_receipts.cryptography: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) over RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON

interop_with_vibe.atc_card_id: co-sign or cite (does NOT replace settle receipt)

bundles.returns: Array of skill bundles with discounts

skill_schema.name: string, human-readable
skill_schema.slug: string, URL-safe, used in install command
skill_schema.description: string, real description from source repository
skill_schema.tags: string[], keywords for search and filtering
skill_schema.price: number, USD (always 0 — MarketNow does not sell skills. If seller_priced=true, the seller set this price and MarketNow takes 5% commission.)
skill_schema.seller_priced: boolean — false (default) means MarketNow free skill; true means a third-party seller set the price
skill_schema.license: string, always 'AliceLabs LLC' (MarketNow licenses are issued by AliceLabs LLC)
skill_schema.verified: boolean — DEPRECATED. True only for human-reviewed skills (43 today). Use review_status instead.
skill_schema.review_status: string — one of: 'auto-scanned' (Sentinel L1.5 ran, no human review — 8,517 skills today), 'human-reviewed' (a human at AliceLabs inspected the repo — 43 skills today), 'maintainer-verified' (GitHub maintainer signed a claim of authorship — 0 today, program not launched)
skill_schema.permissions: object — { network: string[], filesystem: string[], env_vars: string[], subprocess: bool, disclosure: string }. Declarative only — not enforced at runtime. See /trust.
skill_schema.source: object — { type: 'github' | 'curated' | 'bulk-import', url: str | null, note: string }. Discloses where the skill listing came from.
skill_schema.usdc_disclaimer: string — standard text on every skill explaining USDC is irreversible on-chain and the dispute process
skill_schema.install: string, shell command to install the skill
skill_schema.author: string, upstream repo owner

workflow_for_agents.step_2_evaluate: Read description, tags, sentinel_score, system_prompt preview
workflow_for_agents.step_3_choose_mode: ALL skills in MarketNow are FREE (price=0). Just POST /api/agent-purchase with {skillId} to get the license + system_prompt instantly. If seller_priced=true (rare — third-party seller set a price), then: if you have a mandateId → send USDC, then call agent-purchase with {skillId, mandateId, txHash}. If no mandate → ask the human to create a mandate at /mandates or pay via Stripe.
workflow_for_agents.step_5_install: Run the 'install' field as a shell command, e.g. npx -y @marketnow/install <slug>
workflow_for_agents.step_6_use: Call the skill from your agent runtime using the system_prompt + capabilities returned

authentication.optional: Most read endpoints are public (no auth required)
authentication.obtain_via: Sign up via the web UI at https://marketnow.site/?login=true
